text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down 2–3% over 24 hours, suggesting profit-taking after recent strength, though the broader market remains in greed territory with the Fear & Greed index at 71. Bitcoin's dominance sits at 58.7%, indicating conviction in the major is holding despite the pullback, and $118B in daily volume shows healthy engagement rather than panic exit. The seven-day sentiment shift of +21 points toward greed implies traders still view dips as buying opportunities.
